basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Three-time Founder · AI Product Builder · Production LLM Systems · MBA
basics.summary: Three-time founder who ships production AI agents that move company metrics. At LumApps, built outbound sales agents forecast to generate $4M in approved opportunities per quarter; at Beekeeper led AI products for 10M+ frontline workers; founding engineer at EPFL spin-off Dronistics (Unilever partnership, CES showcase). On the side: PulseView (explainable trading AI, live users), Proplab (AI for real-estate ops), SwissNRI (cross-border fintech, 0-to-MVP in 3 months). Building toward a category-defining AI company; bias to ship, low ego, high standards.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns the AI agent program end-to-end: runtime, orchestration, integrations, governance, and rollout. Operates with founder energy inside a $200M+ ARR org.
highlights: Built and deployed production AI agents for outbound sales (LangChain, FastAPI, GCP). 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $4M in approved opportunities per quarter.

Built AI Brain, an intelligent context layer (Neo4j + Graphiti + Zep) that unifies conversation data, usage analytics, and notes. Surfaces patterns that drive company strategy across product, sales, and CS.
Reports directly to C-level on outcomes, not progress. Owns company-wide AI governance and sales enablement strategy.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Tech lead who operates like a founding engineer. Owns the problem, ships the solution, stays accountable to the metric. Built AI-powered products used by millions while growing the team.
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end as Tech Lead reporting to CIO. Top revenue channel on the platform: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR, 99.99% SLA. Built the team and ran GTM with Sales and PM.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI). 12K+ assets translated; product team iterates without external gatekeepers.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist giving every new signup personalized, high-touch guidance at scale. 100% of customers guided without adding headcount.
Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort. Hired for craft and curiosity; grew engineers who now lead features independently.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Operator and investor lens on AI adoption, architecture, and what makes a company actually ship.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL Spin-off)
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms that made 500+ real-world deliveries possible.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS) with real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization. 500+ deliveries powering a Unilever partnership and a CES Las Vegas showcase. 40% faster, 99.5% safety, zero incidents.
Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that earned customer trust from the first deployment.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at the frontier of robotics. Built Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Foundational AI experience (optimization, search, fitness landscapes, learning from environment) that informs how I approach modern LLM and agentic systems today.

projects.name: PulseView - Explainable AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time AI agents that generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data. Built for my own portfolio first, then opened to retail traders. Core principle: if the model cannot explain the signal, it does not ship.
highlights: Built the full stack solo: agent runtime, real-time market data integrations, signal generation and justification layer, web frontend. Live retail users.
Wedge into a $10B+ retail-trading TAM: explainability as the product, not a feature. Institutional-grade analysis priced for the retail trader.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate Operations
projects.description: Property inspections run on paper, clipboards, and WhatsApp photos. Redesigned the workflow before automating it: built MVP for a fully digital, image-backed, timestamped inspection process. Now building the AI marketing assistant on top.
highlights: Shipped MVP replacing paper-based inspection workflows with structured, image-backed, timestamped records.
Wedge into the SMB real-estate vertical: tools that small teams can adopt without a six-month rollout.

projects.name: SwissNRI - Cross-border Fintech for Swiss-Indians
projects.description: Swiss-Indian families navigating FEMA, DTAA, and Swiss regulations had zero digital help, just spreadsheets and expensive advisors. Built the first platform addressing this underserved market.
highlights: Zero-to-MVP in 3 months. Compliance-first design: regulatory guardrails for both jurisdictions built before features. Early users acquired through community partnerships.
Customer feedback loops drove 40% uplift in satisfaction. Roadmap owned by what users actually asked for.

Looking for exceptional founding potential, visionary thinking, drive to build EUR 10B+ companies, willingness to build decade-spanning businesses. Talent pool application is for the general founder track.
